subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord retain a channel-specific retry if the shared reply-session self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 lands?
rationale: Both PRs recover the identical conflict at different layers, while repository policy favors one canonical path unless layered fallback and its combined retry budget are intentional.

options.title: Shared recovery only
options.body: Use the owner-layer self-heal as the canonical fix and close or narrow this PR if it fully prevents Discord message loss.

options.title: Layer both recoveries
options.body: Keep a bounded Discord fallback with a documented combined retry budget and live exactly-once proof across both layers.

recommendation.title: Shared recovery only
recommendation.body: Use the owner-layer self-heal as the canonical fix and close or narrow this PR if it fully prevents Discord message loss.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest current-main history signal on the refactored Discord dispatch module where this retry is proposed.
